text: Guy and Rosemary Woodhouse [move into the Bramford|trigger|making a new home], a Gothic New York building with a past of witchcraft and murder, beside the meddlesome elderly Castevets. On the night they plan to conceive, a [chocolate mousse with a chalky under-taste|images|food, drink and drugs] leaves Rosemary dreaming of [a demonic presence raping her while the tenants watch|wrong|sexual violation]. Pregnant, gaunt and in pain, wearing a pungent good luck charm, she begins to suspect [her neighbours belong to a Satanic coven|origin|secret worshippers among us].
